source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check MAC Address in OS.
2. Check MAC Address in BIOS.
3. Check MAC Address in BMC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: MAC Addresses in both OS & BIOS should be correct.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; recognizes BIOS manual boundary but omits BMC-side evidence and stable port identity.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds expected MAC rule, OS/BIOS/BMC port correlation, BMC read-only data and no-change boundary.

original_test_intent: Read the approved BMC-port network identity from OS, BIOS and BMC, correlate the same physical/logical port across all views, and compare each value with the platform's expected MAC or derivation rule.
original_method: The agent captures complete read-only OS and BMC inventories with stable device mapping; an operator enters BIOS and records the corresponding MAC field; a comparison table evaluates identities without changing configuration.
manual_activity: BIOS navigation and visual capture are explicit core evidence. OS/BMC automation cannot prove that firmware screen, so the case is MANUAL ONLY.
required_inputs: Expected MAC list, allocation/derivation rule or authoritative asset record
Physical BMC port to BIOS label, BMC interface and OS MAC/PCI mapping
Clarification whether BMC and host/shared-port MACs should match or be related
safety_requirements: Do not change/spoof MACs or alter BIOS/BMC/network settings.
Do not compare interface-order entries; bind each value to physical port and hardware identity.
Preserve duplicate, locally administered, multicast or zero MAC anomalies rather than correcting them.
Do not infer BIOS values from OS/BMC output.
No automatic reboot or reconfiguration after mismatch.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete OS interface/MAC/PCI and BMC port/MAC inventories.
Prepare the port-identity crosswalk and ingest operator-attributed BIOS evidence.
Compare formats, expected rule, duplicates and relationships and report Tool Result.
Do not claim BIOS observation or engineer verdict.
engineer_actions: Define the expected three-view MAC relationship and authoritative value.
Enter BIOS and record the corresponding port MAC.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Useful only for OS discovery; grep/head can omit interfaces/metadata, it lacks stable hardware mapping and omits the source-required BMC value.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use complete structured OS link inventory and documented BMC read API, correlated to operator BIOS evidence by physical port/PCI/device labels.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OS, BIOS and BMC checks plus 10/20-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a row per physical port containing asset expectation, BIOS label/value, BMC interface/value and OS MAC/PCI path, retaining raw evidence from each source.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC firmware, OS/driver and management API/tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform MAC allocation and BMC/shared-port architecture specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable port mapping and BMC evidence without replacing BIOS inspection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; includes the procedure's third view despite criteria shorthand.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Dedicated BMC and host NIC MACs may legitimately differ; equality must not be assumed.

project_override_considerations: The project supplies the normative MAC list/rule and port scope. A comparison may claim only those mapped ports and must distinguish equality from an approved derivation relationship.
expected_evidence: Complete OS MAC/PCI inventory and BMC read-only port inventory
Operator-attributed BIOS photo/transcription for the same port
Comparison/anomaly table, unchanged configuration, Tool Result and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure adds a BMC view while Criteria names OS and BIOS; this is an acceptance-detail omission rather than contradictory facts. The review retains all three and requests the relationship rule.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The identity-comparison intent is clear. Expected values and mapping are readiness inputs, while BIOS evidence is a manual core step.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps OS collection and BIOS operator boundary but restores BMC evidence and stable identity mapping.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its three-source and expected-rule analysis, applying MANUAL ONLY to BIOS acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates raw values, comparison Tool Result and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents comparison of unrelated interfaces or an incorrect assumption that dedicated BMC and host MACs are identical.
independent_technical_reasoning: Two views are scriptable, but the source explicitly requires BIOS. Because firmware-screen observation is core acceptance, manual-only classification is required even though correlation can be automated.
no_automatic_retry: Do not reboot into BIOS again or change/spoof any MAC automatically after mismatch. Preserve values and request owner disposition.
